exposure: inherited thrombophilia with LMWH and low-dose aspirin
cohort: Pregnant women with recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL), comprising 108 diagnosed with inherited thrombophilia and 98 with unexplained RPL.
finding: RPL patients with inherited thrombophilia receiving LMWH and low-dose aspirin had higher live-birth rates and lower miscarriage rates compared to those with unexplained RPL, but also showed an increased risk of preeclampsia and preterm births.
